patch_list: Stops Nepali Patro's ads. Eight byte-asserted edits to libapp.so plus an in-place host rewrite: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length; the interstitial_html dispatch…
